ModMetaData.name: Roguelike (prototype)
ModMetaData.author: Matt
ModMetaData.description:
Throwaway prototype of the roguelike node loop: enter a fresh node map, fill a stockpile quota while the weather keeps getting worse, then leave instantly with only what you can carry.
Start a new game with the "Roguelike run" scenario and pick a starting node on the world map. Requires Harmony.
